method.fixedRules: No parameter optimization in this comparison. Existing10/25 measured from next M15 open; close-only10/25 measured from final completed confirmation candle close, using its body for T1/T2/T3. Anchor-only retains original SL/common target,60/40 risk,75min expiry,all original filters. Full proposal also changes50/50 split,60min expiry,body>=30% and separate exactly1.25R targets. Two valid legs required in full version.
method.execution: Archived qualified universe, unchanged OHLC event-order engine; historicalM15/former freshM1. Next candle open is used only for observed execution paths in new versions, never to calculate the entry levels. Still requires execution candle history. Per-leg300-pip risk cap inherited.
method.limitations: Ideal fractional lots before spread/commission/slippage/swaps, no compounding/margin/daily-stop/aggregate-risk limits. Unknown outcomes excluded and may differ. DD resolved cash only, excludes floating risk. Previously reused data, not independent future validation. Source/live settings unchanged.
